title: Need Capture — short form
description: One screen per need. Ten questions that a DRS can actually be drafted from, with the stream detail left to the specification step. Use this for most captures; the long form is for when a stream reviewer is in the room.

title: Need Capture Questionnaire
description: The single instrument for collecting a need, for all three streams and both portfolios. Led by the portfolio manager in a live interview; the answers become a DRS.

title: Project Data Strategy and Requirement Specification
description: Prioritised, testable requirements derived from a project needs statement, for assessment by the Informatics Platform team. Usually written by the needs-to-requirements skill; open it here to draft or refine one by hand.
